item.title: Bulgaria to Buy 100+ Greek Centauros Anti-Drone Systems Under EU SAFE
item.description: Bulgaria plans to acquire over 100 Greek-made Centauros (Kentauros) anti-drone systems from Hellenic Aerospace Industry under the EU SAFE framework to counter UAV threats.
